# `time_to_millis`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
time_to_millis(time)
```

Returns the number of milliseconds since midnight for the given TIME value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT time_to_millis(TIME'00:00:00');
```

Result:

```text
0
```

```sql
SELECT time_to_millis(TIME'14:30:00');
```

Result:

```text
52200000
```

```sql
SELECT time_to_millis(TIME'14:30:00.5');
```

Result:

```text
52200500
```

```sql
SELECT time_to_millis(TIME'23:59:59.999');
```

Result:

```text
86399999
```
